#!/bin/bash

# Docker Cleanup Script
# This script uses environment variables to configure cleanup scope and filters

set -e

# Color codes for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Default values (can be overridden by environment variables)
CLEANUP_SCOPE="${CLEANUP_SCOPE:-all}"
CLEANUP_FILTERS="${CLEANUP_FILTERS:-}"
DRY_RUN="${DRY_RUN:-false}"
VERBOSE="${VERBOSE:-false}"
CLEANUP_IMAGES="${CLEANUP_IMAGES:-true}"
CLEANUP_CONTAINERS="${CLEANUP_CONTAINERS:-true}"
CLEANUP_VOLUMES="${CLEANUP_VOLUMES:-false}"
CLEANUP_NETWORKS="${CLEANUP_NETWORKS:-false}"
FORCE_CLEANUP="${FORCE_CLEANUP:-false}"

# Logging functions
log_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Print configuration
print_config() {
    echo -e "\n${GREEN}=== Docker Cleanup Configuration ===${NC}"
    echo "Cleanup Scope: $CLEANUP_SCOPE"
    echo "Cleanup Filters: ${CLEANUP_FILTERS:-'(none)'}"
    echo "Dry Run Mode: $DRY_RUN"
    echo "Verbose Mode: $VERBOSE"
    echo "Cleanup Images: $CLEANUP_IMAGES"
    echo "Cleanup Containers: $CLEANUP_CONTAINERS"
    echo "Cleanup Volumes: $CLEANUP_VOLUMES"
    echo "Cleanup Networks: $CLEANUP_NETWORKS"
    echo "Force Cleanup: $FORCE_CLEANUP"
    echo -e "${GREEN}=====================================${NC}\n"
}

# Cleanup stopped containers
cleanup_containers() {
    log_info "Starting container cleanup..."
    
    if [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "all" ] || [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "containers" ]; then
        local filter_args=""
        if [ -n "$CLEANUP_FILTERS" ]; then
            filter_args="--filter $CLEANUP_FILTERS"
        fi
        
        local cmd="docker container prune -f $filter_args"
        
        if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
            log_warn "DRY RUN: Would execute: $cmd"
            docker ps -a $filter_args
        else
            log_info "Executing: $cmd"
            eval $cmd
            log_info "Container cleanup completed"
        fi
    else
        log_warn "Container cleanup skipped (scope: $CLEANUP_SCOPE)"
    fi
}

# Cleanup dangling images
cleanup_images() {
    log_info "Starting image cleanup..."
    
    if [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "all" ] || [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "images" ]; then
        local filter_args=""
        if [ -n "$CLEANUP_FILTERS" ]; then
            filter_args="--filter $CLEANUP_FILTERS"
        fi
        
        local cmd="docker image prune -f $filter_args"
        
        if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
            log_warn "DRY RUN: Would execute: $cmd"
            docker images $filter_args
        else
            log_info "Executing: $cmd"
            eval $cmd
            log_info "Image cleanup completed"
        fi
    else
        log_warn "Image cleanup skipped (scope: $CLEANUP_SCOPE)"
    fi
}

# Cleanup unused volumes
cleanup_volumes() {
    log_info "Starting volume cleanup..."
    
    if [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "all" ] || [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "volumes" ]; then
        local cmd="docker volume prune -f"
        
        if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
            log_warn "DRY RUN: Would execute: $cmd"
            docker volume ls
        else
            log_info "Executing: $cmd"
            eval $cmd
            log_info "Volume cleanup completed"
        fi
    else
        log_warn "Volume cleanup skipped (scope: $CLEANUP_SCOPE)"
    fi
}

# Cleanup unused networks
cleanup_networks() {
    log_info "Starting network cleanup..."
    
    if [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "all" ] || [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "networks" ]; then
        local cmd="docker network prune -f"
        
        if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
            log_warn "DRY RUN: Would execute: $cmd"
            docker network ls
        else
            log_info "Executing: $cmd"
            eval $cmd
            log_info "Network cleanup completed"
        fi
    else
        log_warn "Network cleanup skipped (scope: $CLEANUP_SCOPE)"
    fi
}

# Full system cleanup
full_cleanup() {
    log_info "Starting full Docker system cleanup..."
    
    local cmd="docker system prune -f"
    if [ "$FORCE_CLEANUP" = "true" ]; then
        cmd="$cmd -a"
    fi
    
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
        log_warn "DRY RUN: Would execute: $cmd"
        docker system df
    else
        log_info "Executing: $cmd"
        eval $cmd
        log_info "Full system cleanup completed"
    fi
}

# Main execution
main() {
    print_config
    
    if [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" = "system" ]; then
        full_cleanup
    else
        [ "$CLEANUP_CONTAINERS" = "true" ] && cleanup_containers
        [ "$CLEANUP_IMAGES" = "true" ] && cleanup_images
        [ "$CLEANUP_VOLUMES" = "true" ] && cleanup_volumes
        [ "$CLEANUP_NETWORKS" = "true" ] && cleanup_networks
    fi
    
    log_info "Docker cleanup script completed successfully"
    
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
        log_warn "This was a DRY RUN - no changes were made"
    fi
}

# Run main function
main "$@"

# Docker Cleanup Cron Job
# Weekly cleanup every Sunday at midnight
# Install with: crontab -e or cat docker_cleanup.cron | crontab -

0 0 * * 0 bash /tmp/mcp-workspace/docker_cleanup.sh >> /var/log/docker_cleanup.log 2>&1
